# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/hcloud
# args: 
Manage Load Balancers

Usage:
  hcloud load-balancer [command]

Aliases:
  load-balancer, loadbalancer, load-balancers, loadbalancers

General:
  add-label                Add a label to a Load Balancer
  change-algorithm         Changes the algorithm of a Load Balancer
  change-type              Change type of a Load Balancer
  create                   Create a Load Balancer
  delete                   Delete a Load Balancer
  describe                 Describe a Load Balancer
  list                     List Load Balancer
  remove-label             Remove a label from a Load Balancer
  update                   Update a Load Balancer

Protection:
  disable-protection       Disable resource protection for a Load Balancer
  enable-protection        Enable resource protection for a Load Balancer

Targets:
  add-target               Add a target to a Load Balancer
  remove-target            Remove a target from a Load Balancer

Services:
  add-service              Add a service to a Load Balancer
  delete-service           Deletes a service from a Load Balancer
  update-service           Updates a service from a Load Balancer

Network:
  attach-to-network        Attach a Load Balancer to a Network
  detach-from-network      Detach a Load Balancer from a Network

Public Interface:
  disable-public-interface Disable the public interface of a Load Balancer
  enable-public-interface  Enable the public interface of a Load Balancer

Additional Commands:
  metrics                  [ALPHA] Metrics from a Load Balancer
  set-rdns                 Change reverse DNS of a Load Balancer

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for load-balancer

Global Flags:
      --config string              Config file path (default "~/.config/hcloud/cli.toml")
      --context string             Currently active context
      --debug                      Enable debug output
      --debug-file string          File to write debug output to
      --endpoint string            Hetzner Cloud API endpoint (default "https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1")
      --hetzner-endpoint string    Hetzner API endpoint (default "https://api.hetzner.com/v1")
      --http-timeout duration      Timeout for HTTP requests (default 0 = no timeout)
      --no-experimental-warnings   If true, experimental warnings are not shown
      --poll-interval duration     Interval at which to poll information, for example action progress (default 500ms)
      --quiet                      If true, only print error messages

Use "hcloud load-balancer [command] --help" for more information about a command.
